This circuit produces massive sustain and wooly, distortion-like fuzz, ideal for downtuned guitar and bass. All pedal orders ship via Fedex 2Day or Fedex International Priority and typically arrive within 1-3 business days. Availability: In stock Fuzzcoven quantity Add to cart SKU: DID-FC Category: Pedals Tags: does it doom , doom metal , fuzzcoven , pedals Description Reviews (39)   Run it as your main dirt source into a high headroom amplifier or blend it with the tone of your overdriven preamp for a thick low end and pronounced midrange, while maintaining high end clarity. From Kyuss to Conan and everything in between, the Fuzzcoven is extremely responsive to your guitar’s volume and tone control settings, with the ability to go from a thick, saturated fuzz to glassy cleans with the roll of a knob. A low noise floor is achieved via power filtering, high quality surface-mounted design, and low noise transistors. Controls Fuzz: Controls the overall output volume of the fuzz. Fuzz is maxed internally and can be adjusted via an internal trim pot. Power Use only a standard 9v DC power supply with a 2.1mm negative-center barrel. An isolated power supply is recommended. Power supply not included. Specs One-knob silicon fuzz device for guitar and bass Relay-based, true bypass soft switching Regulated internal voltage with overvoltage, overcurrent, and reverse polarity protection Adjustable maximum fuzz via internal trim pot Adjustable LED brightness via internal trim pot Premium components including Neutrik input/output jacks, Lumberg power jack, Alpha pot, Panasonic relay, metal LED bezel, and mil-spec aircraft grade wire Powder coated finish with clear coat and textured heavy gloss UV printed artwork 4.75” x 2.625” x 2.375” 8.8oz 39 reviews for Fuzzcoven Rated 5 out of 5 AllegedlyMichael – August 10, 2021 Couldn’t recommend this pedal enough!
